sources.snippet: Persona Data Model Relevant source files This page documents the Persona object structure, which is the core data model representing a custom AI persona in the QwenPersona system. Each Persona encapsulates a complete configuration for AI behavior including model selection, system prompts, and feature settings.

sources.title: kev1nweng/qwen-persona | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: QwenPersona is a Tampermonkey userscript that extends Qwen Chat with custom persona management capabilities. It allows users to define, save, and switch between AI personas, each with its own model selection, system prompts, and feature settings.
